t: You're at the Sherlock Holmes Museum on Baker Street, near the north end, close to Regent's Park. It's a privately run museum, and it's the world's first dedicated to the fictional detective. It opened in 1990 and was founded by Grace Aidiniantz. The door carries the number 221B by permission of the City of Westminster, though the building actually sits between numbers 237 and 241. So the famous address is a kind of friendly fiction, made official.
